criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input-purposes list, such as name, email, address or card number. This field sets a company spend-policy threshold in dollars ($75), which maps to none of them, so autocomplete="garbage" does not fail 1.3.5. The value is invalid HTML and most likely a way to stop browser autofill, but no A or AA criterion requires a valid token on such a field. 4.1.2 is unaffected: the ax probe shows role textbox with the name Receipt required if transaction amount exceeds. 3.3.2 is met by the visible label.
